channel.title: Global Arbitration Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Arbitration Review (globalarbitrationreview.com)

item.title: Dutch boutique hires superyacht specialist
item.description: Ex-Houthoff lawyer Glenn Hoek has joined Dutch disputes boutique 4DArbitration as head of its superyacht practice.

item.title: Seladore Legal hires from Milbank
item.description: Energy and infrastructure-focused disputes practitioner Peter Edworthy has left Milbank after more than a decade to join the partnership at London-headquartered boutique Seladore Legal.

item.title: South Korea wins partial set-aside of hedge fund’s award
item.description: A UK court has partly upheld South Korea’s jurisdictional challenge to a US$108 million investment treaty award won by US hedge fund Elliott Associates, finding that actions taken by a public pension fund were not attributable to the state.

item.title: Oilfield consortium launches treaty claim against Kazakhstan
item.description: An international consortium has reportedly launched an investment treaty claim against Kazakhstan to challenge a US$5 billion environmental fine imposed over the Kashagan oilfield – as the state continues to pursue a separate US$200 billion contractual claim concerning the project.

item.title: Tokyo event considers impact of global trade turmoil
item.description: A conference organised by the Japan Association of Arbitrators and Swiss Arbitration Association considered the upheaval in international trade and its impact on international arbitration. Andrew Halliwell of Anderson Mori & Tomotsune reports.

item.title: Nigeria defeats claim over e-procurement system
item.description: Nigeria says it has defeated a UK technology company’s US$6.2 million claim over a contract to design and maintain a national electronic government procurement system.

item.title: EFILA looks beyond Europe with relaunch
item.description: The European Federation for Investment Law and Arbitration has relaunched as IFILA and shifted its headquarters from Brussels to the Netherlands as it expands its focus beyond Europe.

item.title: UAE group confirms counsel for Libya claim
item.description: An Emirati conglomerate says it has appointed White & Case as it prepares to file a US$1.7 billion investment treaty claim against Lebanon over funds deposited in the country’s banks.

item.title: German chemical producer sees off post-M&A claim
item.description: BASF, one of the largest chemical companies in the world, has defeated a post-M&A claim worth €168 million at the German Arbitration Institute.

item.title: OMV wins another award against Gazprom
item.description: A Russian court has ordered Austria’s OMV not to enforce a previously undisclosed ICC award against Gazprom – the latest in a string of awards the company has obtained against the Russian entity.
